description: This file defines the `SessionActorQueue` class, which manages asynchronous queueing of session-specific operations using a keyed asynchronous queue. It tracks pending operations per session and provides methods to retrieve queue state and perform queued actions.

classes.name: SessionActorQueue
classes.description: A class that manages a queue of asynchronous operations for different sessions identified by actor keys, tracking pending operations and providing methods to enqueue actions and retrieve queue status.

methods.name: getTailMapForTesting
methods.description: Returns the internal tail map of the queue for testing purposes.

methods.name: getTotalPendingCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of pending operations across all sessions.

methods.name: getPendingCountForSession
methods.description: Returns the number of pending operations for a specific session identified by the actor key.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Enqueues a new asynchronous operation associated with a given actor key, updating the pending count accordingly, and returning the operation's result.
